title: Design From base
description: The whole Design From system in one install: theme tokens, the three fonts, utilities, your icon library and your primitive library.
docs: Installed the Design From base: theme tokens (light and dark), Figtree, JetBrains Mono and Instrument Serif, `cn`, `useReducedMotion`, `composeRefs`, your icon library and your primitive library, and the `@designfrom` registry namespace. Add components with `npx shadcn@latest add @designfrom/<item>`.
